provider_evidence_records.field_family: Massive/Polygon stock plan pricing, API-key access, quota framing, non-professional restrictions, and market-data terms for US market-data candidate use.

evidence_source_refs.evidence_note: WebFetched on 2026-05-28 at https://massive.com/pricing. Official pricing page describes individual Stocks tiers including free Basic, paid Starter, Developer, and Advanced plans, API-call and history-depth differences, and separate business pricing. This records cost and quota candidates only; it does not approve a plan. This verifies the Massive docs page was accessible; it does not independently prove Polygon-to-Massive rebrand.

WebFetched on 2026-05-28 at https://massive.com/docs/rest/quickstart. Official docs require a user API key, allow query-string or Authorization-header authentication, warn against sharing the key, and describe client libraries as handling authentication, request formatting, retry logic, and JSON parsing. This verifies the Massive docs page was accessible; it does not independently prove Polygon-to-Massive rebrand.

WebFetched on 2026-05-28 at https://massive.com/docs/rest/stocks/overview. Official docs describe broad US market coverage, endpoint plan tiers, SIP / FINRA data-source framing, non-industry-professional personal-use framing, and business plans as a separate path. This verifies the Massive docs page was accessible; it does not independently prove Polygon-to-Massive rebrand.

evidence_source_refs.source_title: Massive / Polygon Market Data Terms of Service
evidence_source_refs.evidence_note: WebFetched on 2026-05-28 at https://massive.com/terms/market_data_terms.pdf. Market-data terms restrict use to personal, non-business, non-commercial purposes unless separately permitted; impose redistribution, display, non-display, third-party-provider, professional-status, suspension/change, deletion-on-termination, and no-warranty constraints. This verifies the Massive docs page was accessible; it does not independently prove Polygon-to-Massive rebrand.

missing_required_evidence: User-approved plan choice and cost ceiling for any paid tier.
User status classification and whether intended local research, caching, derived reports, and private non-display use are permitted under the selected plan.
Written or clearly documented authorization for local storage, retained derived artifacts, and any business or professional classification if applicable.
Actual coverage counts, delisted coverage, corporate-action revision behavior, and endpoint response validation.
Operational stability evidence: outage history, incident handling, retry policy, quota enforcement, and support response expectations.
limitations: The pricing and terms evidence is enough to classify Massive/Polygon authorization and cost as reviewable, but not enough to approve provider selection.

The terms create explicit blockers for non-display use, local storage, redistribution, professional status, data changes, suspension, and deletion-on-termination until a later reviewed decision resolves them.

provider_evidence_records.field_family: Norgate US stock package pricing, subscription, free trial, Windows / plugin access, local proprietary database, export, license, and stability constraints.

evidence_source_refs.evidence_note: WebFetched on 2026-05-28 at https://norgatedata.com/stockmarketpackages.php. Official package page lists US Stock package tiers, USD-denominated prices, history depth by tier, and Platinum / Diamond support for delisted securities and historical index constituents.

WebFetched on 2026-05-28 at https://norgatedata.com/index.php/pricing/. Official overview states Norgate specializes in survivorship-bias-free US, Australian, and Canadian EOD data, does not provide live/delayed/intraday/tick data, stores data on a Windows machine in a proprietary database, and provides subscription-only access.

WebFetched on 2026-05-28 at https://norgatedata.com/freetrial.php. Official page says 3-week free trials are available for data packages, US stock trials are offered at Platinum level with limited 2-year history, and unauthorized repeat trials are cancelled.

WebFetched on 2026-05-28 at https://norgatedata.com/accessibility.php. Official page says access is via supported plugins or APIs, including Python on Windows, and that ASCII export covers historical price and volume data but not other data features.

evidence_source_refs.source_title: Norgate Data End User Licensing Agreement
evidence_source_refs.evidence_note: WebFetched on 2026-05-28 at https://norgatedata.com/subscribe/eula.php. EULA grants non-exclusive personal-use rights, permits installation on two normally accessed computers and backup copy of the database, restricts redistribution and commercial use, says access ends if a subscription lapses, and disclaims uninterrupted, error-free, or unchanging data access.

missing_required_evidence: User-approved subscription tier, cost ceiling, and trial authorization.
Confirmed local Windows / Python access path for all needed fields, especially non-price features and index membership.
License review for storing project artifacts, derived reports, and any export beyond historical price and volume.
Retention and reproducibility policy if a subscription lapses and the database becomes inaccessible.
Provider incident, uptime, correction, revision, and retry-stability evidence.
limitations: Norgate remains a strong candidate for survivorship-aware historical EOD and membership research, but it is subscription, Windows, plugin/API, and license constrained.
Norgate does not provide live, delayed, intraday, or tick data, so it cannot satisfy US-short or burst intraday needs alone.

provider_evidence_records.field_family: Norgate current fundamentals evidence and latest-only limitation for US-long observed-date financial-statement reconstruction.

evidence_source_refs.evidence_note: WebFetched on 2026-05-28 at https://norgatedata.com/data-content-tables.php. Official table states current fundamentals and broker forecast information are current only, historical data is not available, and listed dates represent reporting-period dates rather than observed filing availability.

WebFetched on 2026-05-28 at https://norgatedata.com/data-package-faq.php. Official FAQ answers that packages with Fundamentals do not provide historical fundamentals because information is on a latest company report basis.

missing_required_evidence: Historical point-in-time financial statement facts with filing observed dates.
Restatement, amendment, duplicate accession, fiscal-period alignment, unit, and currency normalization evidence.
Coverage and history-depth report for the US-long universe.
Alternative provider candidates for fundamentals and filing observed-date reconstruction.
limitations: Norgate current fundamentals are latest-only and should not be used as historical PIT fundamentals for US-long evidence.
This blocker does not reduce Norgate's separate usefulness as a survivorship-aware historical EOD and index-membership candidate.

Listing, delisting, ADR, SPAC, ETF, ST, suspension, or security-master coverage changes.
Split, dividend, restatement, revised fundamentals, or adjustment behavior changes.
Market calendar, holiday, half-day, timezone, pre-market, after-hours, or benchmark alignment changes.
License scope, local-storage permission, quota, cost, or throttling changes.
Provider outage, retry instability, delayed data, or incident notice affects required evidence.
Outlier rate, revision rate, zero-volume anomalies, or return spikes exceed reviewed expectations.
